# High Roller Technologies Appoints Flip Pidot as Chief Business Officer


October 13, 2026 8:32 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_6e54525fa9c361e0a4143d4ba5ea28ae/highroller/news/2026-10-13_High_Roller_Technologies_Appoints_Flip_Pidot_as_169.pdf)


*Prediction markets entrepreneur brings more than 17 years of experience in market development, trading and commercial strategy*


LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- High Roller Technologies, Inc. (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced that Flip Pidot, CFA, has joined the Company as Chief Business Officer. In this newly created role, Pidot will lead business development and strategic partnerships for High Roller’s prediction markets business, identifying opportunities to expand distribution, deepen industry relationships and support commercial growth. Reporting to CEO Seth Young, Pidot will work closely with the Company’s product, technology and operations teams to translate market insights and partner relationships into a compelling experience for ROLR users.


“Flip has spent nearly two decades building, operating and trading prediction markets, with expertise spanning consumer platforms, institutional trading, event contract design and quantitative research,” said Seth Young, Chief Executive Officer of High Roller Technologies. “He understands what attracts participants, how well-designed markets work and what commercial partners need to succeed. That experience will be valuable as we bring ROLR to a broader audience, expand our partnerships and build a business positioned for sustained growth.”


“Prediction markets have reached a point where the quality of the customer experience and the strength of commercial relationships will increasingly determine which businesses succeed,” said Flip Pidot, Chief Business Officer. “High Roller has assembled an experienced team and a strong foundation for ROLR. I look forward to helping connect that platform with partners and participants, broaden its reach and build lasting value for the Company.”


**About Flip Pidot**


Pidot founded American Civics Exchange in 2008 to develop an institutional marketplace for political and event-based risk products. His subsequent ventures include The Super Market, a white label, self-serve prediction market platform; Polyoptions, which develops options and trading tools for prediction market participants; and ACE OTC, a marketplace for bespoke event futures serving institutions and high-net-worth individuals. In addition, his responsibilities at PredictIt included contract design, settlement rules and liquidity development, as well as quantitative research across political, macroeconomic, cryptocurrency and sports markets.


Pidot began his investment career at Boyar Asset Management and serves on the board of the Coalition for Political Forecasting. A CFA charterholder, he holds an MBA from the University of Virginia’s Darden School of Business and a bachelor’s degree in economics from the University of Notre Dame.
